description: List top-ups that stopped because the cardholder's bank wants them to confirm — the money has not moved and the wallet was not credited. Use when a user asks whether a top-up went through, when a balance is lower than they expect after topping up, or when top_up_wallet returned a verification link earlier in the conversation and you need to know whether it was ever followed. A balance check cannot answer this: an unconfirmed charge looks identical to one that was never attempted. Read-only and free, and it returns no credential — completing the challenge happens in a browser, from the link the user was given, and nothing here can finish a payment on their behalf.
name: list_pending_verifications
